context:
Goal: find why HISTORY-ROW-HEAD and R4-ROWACT are 1px off on CI only, without waiting on you.
Problem (rule): a cloud session can start browser.yml (gh api works), but q_max CLAUDE.md, Commands, says CI runs the browser suite only when you start it (the owner, 2026-10-02; D-748). The env var was not the block. A run inside the container cannot show a 1px gap that happens only on CI.
Based on (read): q_max CLAUDE.md, Commands section.
Departs from: q_max lets only you start browser.yml — a session may start it on a non-main diagnostic branch.
home: lane qmax-browser-main-red reads the run log
